name: std-algo-floodfill
description: Flood fill — each tick dequeues one cell, recolours it, and enqueues its 4-neighbours sharing the seed's value on algorithm-canvas cells.

schema.name: std-algo-floodfill
schema.description: Flood fill — each tick dequeues one cell, recolours it, and enqueues its 4-neighbours sharing the seed's value on algorithm-canvas cells.

emits.description: The grid each step — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op standalone.

events.name: Cells Updated
events.description: The grid each step — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op standalone.

seedId.label: Seed Cell
seedId.description: Id (row*cols+col) of the cell the flood starts from; its value defines the region.

cells.label: Cells
cells.description: The initial grid; value 1 = the seeded region, 2 = a second region, 0 = background.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick fills one cell per step; toggle to start/pause the flood.
